versions.changelog: Refined OpenClaw metadata so only true hard requirements are marked required. Kept IMA credentials required, moved Feishu placement variables to optional envs, and documented FEISHU_KB_ID / FEISHU_FOLDER_ID routing aliases plus FEISHU_IMPORT_ENDPOINT guidance.
Clarified Feishu CLI transport requirements for OpenClaw, documented runtime dependencies in skill metadata, and tightened OpenClaw/ClawHub compatibility metadata.

Initial public release.

- Added OpenClaw- and Codex-compatible skill for structured knowledge base organization and multi-destination sync (Obsidian, Feishu, Tencent IMA).
- Implements duplicate detection, tag validation, image downloading, summary generation, and related-note suggestions.
- Includes scripts for importing, normalizing, syncing, and contract enforcement for notes and articles.
- Provides comprehensive workflow and execution rules for browser, web, and Xiaohongshu/WeChat article imports.
- Supplied extensive documentation (README, SKILL.md, INSTALL.md) and use case-oriented guides.
- Added skill promotion content and platform-specific usage documentation.
Add --disable switch for selected sync destinations
Add usage examples for Obsidian, Feishu, and IMA
Add Feishu and IMA usage guidance
Remove Obsidian branding from public metadata
Sync WeChat and Xiaohongshu import guidance
Broaden image field alias support and share parsing logic
Switch skill page to English for ClawHub publishing
Add English introduction for ClawHub publish page
